emily: Heads-up — I'm planning a micro-patch from 1.12.5 -> 1.12.6 to backport the kvcache timeout fix. Minimal diff, no schema changes. Targeting cutoff in ~30m. Can owners ack PRs and run a quick smoke? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ashwin: Acked PR #4832 (cherry-pick ready). Starting quick smoke on staging now.
kai: I'll prep the changelog blurb and tag. Can someone confirm rollout window? prefer < 1h ramp.
sasha: Prefer low-traffic window — ok for us if canary starts in 30m. What's the canary split?
emily: Plan: 10% canary for 15m, then 50% for 10m if no regressions, then 100% cut. Rollback to previous variant is available. Cutoff reminder: i'll cut branch in 30m (thread ts).
ashwin: Smoke results: basic inference + kv hit/miss looks normal. No obvious latency spike. Logs: `kvcache::timeout` not reproducing on staging.
ashwin: command I used:
```
# smoke script (local)
curl -sS -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello","max_tokens":1}' | jq .
curl -sS https://staging-api.redwood.ai/internal/kvcache/stats | jq .
```
kai: Changelog blurb drafted: "Fix: backport kvcache timeout regression causing elevated memory use under burst (1.12.6)" — pushing to release-notes/1.12.6.md now.
(emily): here's the cherry-pick steps if anyone needs to do manual backport:
```
git checkout stable/1.12
git fetch origin
git cherry-pick --no-commit 8f7a2c4
# resolve conflicts (should be none)
git commit -m "patch: fix kvcache timeout (1.12.6)"
git push origin stable/1.12
```
ashwin: All green on staging smoke. I also ran a quick KV evictions check — numbers stable.
sasha: Deploy window confirmed. Ops: please avoid rolling other platform changes during the canary.
deploy-bot: release tag created: v1.12.6 by emily — artifacts available in CI (build 5782).
kai: I'll kick the canary in 10m and watch tracing + error rates.
emily: Thanks — folks, please watch Slack and incidents channel for any alerts. If no issues, i'll roll to 100% after the 25m watch.
ashwin: Pinged on-call. I'll hold a rollback branch ready just in case.
sasha: noted. will hold traffic shift if SLOs degrade.
emily: cutting now in T-5m. final sanity check: anyone seeing any blocker?
ashwin: none here, go ahead. :thumbsup:
kai: go for it.
emily: rolling canary -> 10% now. will update.
(emily): canary deployed — traces look normal at first glance. monitoring 15m.
deploy-bot: canary: 10% -> observed error rate 0.12% (baseline 0.10%). No regressions flagged.
emily: bumping to 50% now.
deploy-bot: routed 50% traffic. metrics stable.
emily: rolling to 100%.
deploy-bot: rollout complete. release v1.12.6 -> stable/1.12 promoted.
kai: changelog PR merged and release notes updated.
sasha: closing ops window. all clear from infra side.
emily: huge thanks — will send patch announcement and update the support playbook with the rollback steps. :confetti_ball:
ashwin: nice quick turnaround.
end of thread
